name: dbx-trace
description: Flight recorder for Databricks: every query, script and guardrail block Claude makes, in a band above the prompt and a per-session HTML trace with deep links

workspace_host.title: Workspace URL
workspace_host.description: Databricks workspace base URL for deep links, e.g. https://adb-1234567890123456.7.azuredatabricks.net

workspace_id.title: Workspace ID
workspace_id.description: Azure workspace ID; appended to links as ?o=<id>. Leave blank on AWS/GCP.

user_email.title: Your Databricks identity
user_email.description: Entra email that system.query.history records as executed_by. Blank uses current_user().

mcp_tool_pattern.title: Databricks MCP tool pattern
mcp_tool_pattern.description: Regex over MCP tool names (mcp__<server>__<tool>) that run SQL

sql_arg_names.title: SQL argument names
sql_arg_names.description: Comma-separated argument names that carry the SQL text on those tools

enrich_tool.title: Enrichment tool
enrich_tool.description: Full MCP tool name used to read system.query.history; blank reuses the last Databricks SQL tool Claude called

prod_catalogs.title: Prod catalogs
prod_catalogs.description: Comma-separated catalogs drawn red (writes are flagged)

enrich.title: Enrich from query history
enrich.description: Read system.query.history at the end of each turn for duration, bytes and rows
